title: A MERCHANT-ISSUED REFUND on a loan marked charged off and not fraud credits CHARGE_OFF_EXPENSE 900.00 then debits the resolved fund source 7 900.00 exactly ONCE (loan 50 L498)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the journal entry a MERCHANT-ISSUED REFUND posted on a loan ALREADY MARKED CHARGED OFF under createJournalEntriesForRepaymentWhenLoanIsChargedOff, on the Tier-D MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits, product LP2_ADV_PYMNT_INT_DAILY_EMI_ACTUAL_ACTUAL_INT_REFUND_FULL_ACCELERATE_MATURITY_CHARGE_OFF / loanProductId 98, loan 50 chargedOff true, fraud false) at refund transaction L498. request.charged_off_merchant_refund_journal.portions transcribes the loan read-back's merchantIssuedRefund transaction id 498 (externalId 5e98395f-93f1-4142-8d7d-4d9e61590633, type Merchant Issued Refund, paymentDetailData.paymentType.id 4): principalPortion 900.0 -> "90000" and every other portion 0. The port REFUSES a fraud loan, so request.charged_off_merchant_refund_journal.fraud is false, matching the read-back's fraud false. request.charged_off_merchant_refund_journal.accounts is the accepted create request product-mappings/create-request-LP2_ADV_PYMNT_INT_DAILY_EMI_ACTUAL_ACTUAL_INT_REFUND_FULL_ACCELERATE_MATURITY_CHARGE_OFF.json's accountingMappings with the fund source RESOLVED through the payment channel: chargeOffExpenseAccountId 18, incomeFromChargeOffInterestAccountId 16, incomeFromChargeOffFeesAccountId 12, incomeFromChargeOffPenaltyAccountId 12, overpaymentLiabilityAccountId 13, incomeFromRecoveryAccountId 17, fundSourceAccountId 7; the ONLY paymentChannelToFundSourceMappings entry is paymentTypeId 1 -> 19, so paymentType 4 (AUTOPAY) has no channel mapping and resolves to the product fund source 7. expect.charged_off_merchant_refund_journal_legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the two L498 legs in id order from the journal-entries sweep: JE 1334 CREDIT glAccountId 18 900.00, JE 1335 DEBIT glAccountId 7 900.00. THIS VECTOR GRADES ONE PROPERTY: a merchant-issued refund on a charged-off, non-fraud loan CREDITS a positive principal portion to CHARGE_OFF_EXPENSE and DEBITs the total exactly ONCE to the resolved fund source. A port that posts the refund through the charged-off REPAYMENT layout instead routes the principal credit to INCOME_FROM_RECOVERY 17, so the one credit's account moves from 18 to 17 while the count, every side, every amount and the single fund-source debit stay observed. WHAT THIS VECTOR DOES NOT GRADE: a positive interest, fee, penalty or overpayment portion (all are zero here), a merged multi-portion credit, the fraud split (the port refuses a fraud loan), the method's unobserved payout-refund and goodwill-credit arms, or a zero-total case. Nothing was computed by this promotion: every portion, every account and every expected leg is read directly from the committed files.
